title: The Lord shows the bread
english: The Lord, in divinity and in humanity, without confusion and without division, confirming the divine nature and the human nature by the divine signs and by the human sufferings, about to come to the voluntary, celebrated, and life-giving death on our behalf, took bread in his holy and undefiled hands, showed it to you, God and Father, and having given thanks, blessed, and sanctified it, gave it to his holy disciples.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Institution of the Eucharist
english: Having said to the apostles: Take, eat; this is my body, which is being broken for you for the forgiveness of sins. Likewise, after the supper, having taken a cup and mixing it from two elements, from the fruit of the vine and from water, he sealed the cup of immortality and gave it to his disciples, saying: Drink from it, all of you; this is my blood of the new covenant, which is being poured out for you and for many for the forgiveness of sins.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Body and Blood of the New Covenant
english: May this bread, having been transformed, become the body of Christ: a divine body, a body of salvation for souls and bodies. And that which has been mixed in this cup, the same blood of Christ—the blood of a new covenant—is a salvation to us, so that we all may partake in the mysteries of your saints in the newness of the Spirit and not in the oldness of the letter.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
